"""Camera-guided controller for one ArrangeVegetables episode.
Only uses the robot service's RGB/depth, calibration and proprioception.
Commands and all responses are saved to /app/runs for the record.
"""
import json, sys, pathlib, traceback
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
root = pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
spec = r.spec()
(root/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
print('SPEC',json.dumps(spec), flush=True)
idx=0

def save(res, cmd):
    global idx
    out=root/f'{idx:03d}'
    res.save(str(out))
    (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2))
    cams=list(res.last)
    if cams:
        panel=Image.new('RGB',(640,260*((len(cams)+1)//2)))
        draw=ImageDraw.Draw(panel)
        for n,c in enumerate(cams):
            x=(n%2)*320; y=(n//2)*260
            panel.paste(Image.fromarray(res.last[c]),(x,y+20))
            draw.text((x,y),c,fill='white')
        panel.save(out/'mosaic.png')
    print('RESULT', idx, json.dumps(res.meta), flush=True)
    idx+=1
    return res

last=save(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'),{'op':'initial'})
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        cmd=json.loads(line)
        op=cmd.get('op')
        if op=='observe':
            last=save(r.get_obs(cameras=cmd.get('cameras'),seconds=cmd.get('seconds',0),include_depth=True,video='none'),cmd)
        elif op=='action':
            a=np.array(cmd['a'],dtype=float)
            if a.ndim==1:a=np.tile(a,(cmd.get('n',1),1))
            last=save(r.submit('ee_delta',a,interpolate='hold',cameras=cmd.get('cameras'),include_depth=True,video='none',note=cmd.get('note','')),cmd)
        elif op=='status':print('STATUS',json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
        elif op=='quit':break
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
